instrument: IDA credit *(corrected from the source's "Concessional loan"; PADHI01184 records a US$19.7m IDA credit alongside US$45.3m of IBRD loans)*
title: Digital Eswatini Project
description: Increases access to affordable broadband internet and improves the government's capacity to deliver digital public services. Supports broadband infrastructure deployment, digital government platforms, and digital economy enabling environment in the Kingdom of Eswatini.

title: Construction of Disaster Recovery Site for National Data Centre (RSTP Phase 2)
description: Government of India Line of Credit to Eswatini for construction of a Disaster Recovery Site (DRS) for the national data centre as part of the Royal Science and Technology Park (RSTP) Phase 2. The LoC agreement was signed between India Exim Bank and the Government of Eswatini. The project builds a secondary data centre facility providing business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities for government IT systems and national data assets.

title: Eswatini IFMIS and PFM Capacity Building Project
description: Improves planning and control of public expenditures, investment management, and accountability in the Kingdom of Eswatini through deployment and expansion of an Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS). Supports IFMIS rollout to line ministries, budget execution systems, and internal audit capacity building.

sector: Sectoral management information systems (HMIS, EMIS, etc.)
